183	> \(d\) **Insurance.** Evidence satisfactory to the Administrative Agent that the Borrower maintains insurance coverage consistent with the requirements to be set forth in the Credit Agreement, including commercial general liability, property, and business interruption insurance, with the Administrative Agent named as additional insured and loss payee, as applicable.
184	>
185	> \(e\) **Lien Searches.** Receipt by the Administrative Agent of the results of UCC, tax lien, judgment lien, and pending litigation searches conducted in all relevant jurisdictions with respect to the Borrower and the Guarantor, the results of which shall confirm the priority of the Administrative Agent\'s security interests in the Collateral and shall be otherwise satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
186	>
187	> \(f\) **KYC/AML Compliance.** Satisfactory completion by the Administrative Agent and each Lender of all \"know your customer,\" anti-money laundering, and beneficial ownership due diligence with respect to the Borrower and the Guarantor, including delivery of a Beneficial Ownership Certification in compliance with 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230 and all other information and documentation reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent or any Lender.
188	>
189	> \(g\) **Fees and Expenses.** Payment by the Borrower of all fees, costs, and expenses due and payable on the Closing Date, including (without limitation) upfront arrangement and structuring fees as set forth in the applicable fee letters, the initial annual administrative agent fee, and all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket costs and expenses of the Administrative Agent and its counsel (including the fees and disbursements of Whitfield Crane & Sadler LLP) incurred in connection with the negotiation, preparation, and execution of the loan documents.
190	>
191	> \(h\) **Other Conditions.** Such other conditions as the Administrative Agent or Required Lenders may reasonably require, including delivery of a solvency certificate, a borrowing base certificate (if applicable), evidence of payment of all taxes due, and absence of any material litigation or material adverse change.
192	
193	**[VIII. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES (SUMMARY)]{.underline}**
194	
195	Each of the Borrower and the Guarantor shall make customary representations and warranties in the Credit Agreement and the Guaranty Agreement (as applicable), which representations and warranties shall be made on the Closing Date and, in certain instances, on the date of each borrowing or issuance of a letter of credit (if applicable). The representations and warranties shall include, without limitation, the following:
196	
197	> \(a\) Due organization, valid existence, and good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of formation or incorporation and each jurisdiction in which the conduct of business or ownership of property requires qualification.
198	>
199	> \(b\) Power and authority to enter into and perform the loan documents and to consummate the transactions contemplated thereby.
200	>
201	> \(c\) Due authorization, execution, and delivery of the loan documents, and enforceability of the loan documents as legal, valid, and binding obligations, subject to customary enforceability exceptions (bankruptcy, insolvency, and equitable principles).
202	>
203	> \(d\) No conflict with organizational documents, applicable law, or material contractual obligations.
204	>
205	> \(e\) Compliance in all material respects with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations, including environmental laws.
206	>
207	> \(f\) The financial statements delivered to the Administrative Agent fairly present in all material respects the consolidated financial condition and results of operations of the Guarantor and its subsidiaries as of the dates and for the periods indicated, and have been prepared in accordance with GAAP consistently applied.
208	>
209	> \(g\) Since the date of the most recent audited financial statements, no event, change, or condition has occurred that has had or could reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.
210	>
211	> \(h\) Solvency of each of the Borrower and the Guarantor (on a consolidated basis, after giving effect to the transactions contemplated by the loan documents).
212	>
213	> \(i\) Compliance with ERISA and related pension and benefit plan laws; no ERISA Event has occurred or is reasonably expected to occur that could result in material liability.
214	>
215	> \(j\) All tax returns have been timely filed and all taxes due have been paid, except where contested in good faith with adequate reserves.
216	>
217	> \(k\) Compliance with all applicable environmental laws; no material environmental liabilities.
218	>
219	> \(l\) Compliance with all applicable anti-corruption laws (including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act) and sanctions laws and regulations (including those administered by OFAC, the U.S. Department of State, and the United Nations Security Council).
220	>
221	> \(m\) Such other representations and warranties as are customary for credit facilities of this type and as may be reasonably required by the Administrative Agent and its counsel.
222	
223	**[IX. FINANCIAL COVENANTS]{.underline}**
224	
225	The Credit Agreement shall include the following financial covenants, each of which shall be tested on a quarterly basis as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, based on the consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor:
226	
227	> \(a\) **Maximum Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio.** The Guarantor shall not permit the Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio (defined as the ratio of (i) Consolidated Total Funded Indebtedness minus unrestricted cash and cash equivalents (subject to a cap to be agreed) to (ii) Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarter period) to exceed a maximum level to be agreed upon during documentation negotiations. It is anticipated that the leverage covenant may include step-downs over the life of the Facility and temporary step-ups in connection with Permitted Acquisitions, in each case to be negotiated and set forth in the Credit Agreement.
228	>
229	> \(b\) **Minimum Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio.** The Guarantor shall not permit the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio (defined as the ratio of (i) Consolidated EBITDA for the most recently completed four fiscal quarter period to (ii) Consolidated Cash Interest Expense for such period) to be less than a minimum level to be agreed upon during documentation negotiations. The Interest Coverage Ratio covenant shall be tested quarterly on a trailing four-quarter basis.
230	>
231	> \(c\) **Minimum Liquidity.** The Guarantor shall at all times maintain Liquidity (defined as unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Guarantor and its consolidated subsidiaries, plus available and unused revolving commitments under the Facility) of not less than an amount to be agreed upon during documentation negotiations. Compliance with the Minimum Liquidity covenant shall be tested as of the last day of each fiscal quarter and, if required by the Administrative Agent, at such other times as may be specified in the Credit Agreement.
232	
233	The definitions of \"Consolidated EBITDA,\" \"Consolidated Total Funded Indebtedness,\" \"Consolidated Cash Interest Expense,\" and other financial terms shall be set forth in the Credit Agreement and shall include customary addbacks, exclusions, and pro forma adjustments (including pro forma adjustments for Permitted Acquisitions), in each case as negotiated and agreed by the parties.
234	
235	**[X. AFFIRMATIVE AND NEGATIVE COVENANTS (SUMMARY)]{.underline}**
236	
237	The Credit Agreement shall include customary affirmative and negative covenants applicable to the Borrower and, where specified, the Guarantor and their respective subsidiaries, including the following:
238	
239	**Affirmative Covenants:**
240	
241	> \(a\) Delivery of annual audited consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor within 120 days after the end of each fiscal year, accompanied by an unqualified audit report from a nationally recognized independent accounting firm.
242	>
243	> \(b\) Delivery of quarterly unaudited consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor within 60 days after the end of each fiscal quarter (other than the fourth fiscal quarter).
244	>
245	> \(c\) Delivery of a compliance certificate signed by a financial officer of the Guarantor concurrently with the delivery of annual and quarterly financial statements, certifying compliance with all financial covenants and the absence of any Default or Event of Default.
246	>
247	> \(d\) Prompt notice of the occurrence of any Default or Event of Default, any material litigation, any material ERISA event, or any other event that has had or could reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.
248	>
249	> \(e\) Maintenance of corporate or limited liability company existence and all rights, privileges, and franchises necessary for the conduct of business.
250	>
251	> \(f\) Maintenance and preservation of properties and assets in good working order and condition, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
252	>
253	> \(g\) Maintenance of insurance in amounts and with carriers satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
254	>
255	> \(h\) Granting the Administrative Agent and the Lenders reasonable access and inspection rights to the properties, books, and records of the Borrower and its subsidiaries, subject to customary limitations and confidentiality obligations.
256	>
257	> \(i\) Compliance with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations (including environmental, anti-corruption, and sanctions laws).
258	>
259	> \(j\) Such other affirmative covenants as are customary for credit facilities of this type and as may be reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent.
260	
261	**Negative Covenants:**
262	
263	> \(a\) **Limitations on Indebtedness.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not create, incur, assume, or suffer to exist any indebtedness, except for indebtedness expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement (including customary baskets for purchase money indebtedness, capital leases, intercompany indebtedness, and a general basket in an amount to be agreed).
264	>
265	> \(b\) **Limitations on Liens.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not create, incur, assume, or suffer to exist any lien on any of their properties or assets, except for liens expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement (including customary exceptions for existing liens, purchase money liens, tax liens contested in good faith, and a general basket in an amount to be agreed).
266	>
267	> \(c\) **Limitations on Investments.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not make or hold any investment, except for investments expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement (including customary baskets for cash equivalents, intercompany investments, Permitted Acquisitions, and a general basket in an amount to be agreed).
268	>
269	> \(d\) **Limitations on Restricted Payments.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not declare, pay, or make any dividend, distribution, or other restricted payment, except as expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement (including customary exceptions for tax distributions, payments required under organizational documents, and a general basket subject to compliance with financial covenants on a pro forma basis).
270	>
271	> \(e\) **Limitations on Fundamental Changes.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not merge, consolidate, liquidate, or dissolve, or sell, transfer, or dispose of all or substantially all of their assets, except as expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement.
272	>
273	> \(f\) **Limitations on Asset Sales.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not sell, transfer, lease, or otherwise dispose of any assets other than in the ordinary course of business, except as expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement (subject to minimum thresholds and mandatory prepayment provisions).
274	>
275	> \(g\) **Limitations on Transactions with Affiliates.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not enter into any transaction with any affiliate, except on terms no less favorable than those that would be obtained in an arm\'s-length transaction with a non-affiliated third party, and except as otherwise expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement.
276	>
277	> \(h\) **Limitations on Amendments to Organizational Documents.** The Borrower and its subsidiaries shall not amend, modify, or waive any provision of their organizational documents in any manner that could reasonably be expected to be materially adverse to the interests of the Lenders, without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent.
278	
279	Specific baskets, thresholds, carve-outs, and exceptions applicable to each negative covenant shall be negotiated and set forth in the definitive Credit Agreement. The parties acknowledge that the foregoing summary is illustrative and that the scope of affirmative and negative covenants will be subject to further negotiation.
280	
281	**[XI. EVENTS OF DEFAULT (SUMMARY)]{.underline}**
282	
283	The Credit Agreement shall include customary events of default (each, an \"Event of Default\"), the occurrence and continuance of which shall entitle the Administrative Agent (acting at the direction of the Required Lenders) to accelerate the Obligations and exercise remedies under the loan documents. Events of Default shall include, without limitation, the following:
284	
285	> \(a\) **Payment Defaults.** Failure by the Borrower to pay (i) any principal when due, (ii) any interest within three (3) Business Days after becoming due, or (iii) any fees or other amounts within five (5) Business Days after becoming due.
286	>
287	> \(b\) **Covenant Defaults.** Failure by the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any subsidiary to perform or observe any covenant contained in the Credit Agreement or other loan documents, subject to a cure period of thirty (30) days after written notice from the Administrative Agent for certain affirmative covenants (other than financial covenants and covenants relating to maintenance of existence, which shall have no cure period). No cure period shall apply to breaches of financial covenants or negative covenants.
288	>
289	> \(c\) **Cross-Default and Cross-Acceleration.** (i) A default by the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any material subsidiary under any other agreement or instrument relating to indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount in excess of Ten Million Dollars (\$10,000,000), if the effect of such default is to accelerate or permit the acceleration of the maturity of such indebtedness, or (ii) the failure to pay any such indebtedness when due (after giving effect to any applicable grace period).
290	>
291	> \(d\) **Insolvency and Bankruptcy.** The occurrence of any voluntary or involuntary bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, assignment for the benefit of creditors, or similar event with respect to the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any material subsidiary. Involuntary proceedings shall be subject to a customary sixty (60)-day cure period.
292	>
293	> \(e\) **Judgment Defaults.** Entry of one or more final, non-appealable judgments against the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any material subsidiary in an aggregate amount in excess of an amount to be agreed, to the extent not covered by insurance or indemnity.
294	>
295	> \(f\) **ERISA Events.** The occurrence of one or more ERISA Events that, individually or in the aggregate, could reasonably be expected to result in liability of the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any ERISA Affiliate in an aggregate amount in excess of an amount to be agreed.
296	>
297	> \(g\) **Change of Control.** The occurrence of a Change of Control (to be defined in the Credit Agreement, and expected to include, among other things, any event resulting in (i) the Guarantor ceasing to own, directly or indirectly, 100% of the equity interests of the Borrower, or (ii) any person or group acquiring beneficial ownership of more than 50% of the voting equity interests of the Guarantor).
298	>
299	> \(h\) **Invalidity of Loan Documents.** Any loan document, including the Guaranty Agreement or any Security Agreement or Pledge Agreement, shall cease to be in full force and effect or shall be declared null and void, or the Guarantor or the Borrower shall contest the validity or enforceability of any loan document, or any security interest purported to be created by any security document shall cease to be a valid and perfected first-priority lien (subject to permitted liens).
300	>
301	> \(i\) **Material Adverse Effect.** The occurrence of any event or condition that has had, or could reasonably be expected to have, a Material Adverse Effect (to be defined in the Credit Agreement).
302	
303	Upon the occurrence and continuance of an Event of Default, the Administrative Agent (at the direction of the Required Lenders) shall have the right to (i) declare all outstanding Obligations to be immediately due and payable, (ii) terminate all commitments, and (iii) exercise all rights and remedies available under the loan documents and applicable law. Upon the occurrence of an insolvency or bankruptcy Event of Default, acceleration and termination of commitments shall occur automatically without notice or demand.
304	
305	**[XII. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION]{.underline}**
306	
307	> \(a\) **Governing Law.** The Credit Agreement, the Guaranty Agreement, and each of the other loan documents shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York, without giving effect to conflicts of law principles (other than Section 5-1401 of the New York General Obligations Law).
308	>
309	> \(b\) **Jurisdiction.** Each of the parties shall submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the federal and state courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, City of New York, State of New York, in connection with any action, suit, or proceeding arising out of or relating to the loan documents or the transactions contemplated thereby. Each party irrevocably waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any objection that it may now or hereafter have to the laying of venue of any such action, suit, or proceeding in any such court, and any claim that any such action, suit, or proceeding brought in any such court has been brought in an inconvenient forum.
310	>
311	> \(c\) **Waiver of Jury Trial.** Each of the parties to the Credit Agreement and the other loan documents shall irrevocably and unconditionally waive, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any and all right to trial by jury in any action, suit, proceeding, or counterclaim arising out of or relating to the loan documents or the transactions contemplated thereby. It is contemplated that a waiver of jury trial provision shall be included in each of the Credit Agreement, the Guaranty Agreement, and the other loan documents.
312	>
313	> \(d\) **Service of Process.** Each party shall consent to service of process in any manner permitted by applicable law, including by certified mail addressed to such party at the address set forth in the Credit Agreement.
314	
315	**[XIII. FEES AND EXPENSES]{.underline}**
316	
317	> \(a\) **Agent\'s Counsel Fees.** The Borrower shall pay all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket fees, costs, and expenses of counsel to the Administrative Agent, Whitfield Crane & Sadler LLP, 600 Lexington Avenue, 28th Floor, New York, New York 10022, incurred in connection with the negotiation, preparation, execution, delivery, and administration of the Credit Agreement and the other loan documents, and any amendments, waivers, or consents thereunder. Such fees and expenses shall be payable on the Closing Date and, thereafter, upon demand.
318	>
319	> \(b\) **Arrangement and Structuring Fees.** Upfront arrangement and structuring fees shall be payable by the Borrower to Cascadia National Bank, N.A. as Lead Arranger on the Closing Date, in the amounts and on the terms set forth in one or more separate fee letters between the Borrower and Cascadia National Bank, N.A. (each, a \"Fee Letter\"). The Fee Letters are confidential and shall not be disclosed to the other Lenders (except to the extent of aggregate fee amounts required to be disclosed in the Credit Agreement).
320	>
321	> \(c\) **Administrative Agent Fee.** An annual administrative agent fee shall be payable by the Borrower to Cascadia National Bank, N.A. in its capacity as Administrative Agent, in the amount and on the terms set forth in a separate fee letter between the Borrower and Cascadia National Bank, N.A. The initial annual administrative agent fee shall be payable on the Closing Date, with subsequent installments payable on each anniversary of the Closing Date during the term of the Facility.
322	>
323	> \(d\) **Enforcement Costs.** The Borrower shall pay all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket costs and expenses incurred by the Administrative Agent and each Lender in connection with the enforcement of the loan documents or the protection of rights thereunder, including the fees and disbursements of counsel.
324	>
325	> \(e\) **Indemnification.** The Borrower shall indemnify and hold harmless the Administrative Agent, each Lender, and their respective affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents, and advisors (each, an \"Indemnified Party\") from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, and expenses (including reasonable fees and disbursements of counsel) arising out of or relating to the Facility, the Credit Agreement, or the other loan documents, except to the extent arising from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of such Indemnified Party (as determined by a court of competent jurisdiction in a final, non-appealable judgment).
326	
327	**[XIV. KEY CONTACTS]{.underline}**
328	
329	Correspondence, notices, and communications relating to the Facility and the transactions contemplated by this Term Sheet should be directed to the following key contacts:
330	
331	  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
332	  **Role**                                 **Contact**                                                                **Address**
333	  ---------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------
334	  **Administrative Agent**                 Marcus R. Ellingham, Senior Vice President, Cascadia National Bank, N.A.   900 SW Morrison Street, Suite 2200, Portland, OR 97205
335	
336	  **Guarantor**                            Diana Chow, General Counsel, Terraverde Group, Inc.                        1401 Elm Street, Suite 3500, Dallas, TX 75202
337	
338	  **Agent\'s Counsel**                     Priya Narayan, Partner, Whitfield Crane & Sadler LLP                       600 Lexington Avenue, 28th Floor, New York, NY 10022
339	
340	  **Guarantor\'s / Borrower\'s Counsel**   Thomas Kuo, Partner, Marchetti DeLuca LLP                                  51 West 52nd Street, 34th Floor, New York, NY 10019
341	  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
342	
343	All formal notices under the Credit Agreement and the other loan documents shall be delivered in the manner and to the addresses specified therein.
344	
345	**[XV. DISCLAIMERS AND CONFIDENTIALITY]{.underline}**
346	
347	> \(a\) **Non-Binding Nature.** This Term Sheet is indicative and non-binding. Nothing contained herein shall constitute a commitment, undertaking, agreement, or offer by Cascadia National Bank, N.A., any other Lender, or any of their respective affiliates to provide financing or to enter into any transaction. No party shall have any obligation to negotiate or enter into any definitive documentation based on this Term Sheet, and no party shall have any liability to any other party by reason of the delivery of this Term Sheet or any discussions or negotiations conducted in connection herewith.
348	>
349	> \(b\) **Subject to Diligence and Approval.** All terms and conditions set forth in this Term Sheet are subject to (i) the satisfactory completion by the Administrative Agent and each Lender of business, legal, financial, and environmental due diligence with respect to the Borrower, the Guarantor, and their respective subsidiaries, (ii) the receipt by each Lender of all necessary internal credit, compliance, and risk management approvals, and (iii) the negotiation, execution, and delivery of definitive documentation in form and substance satisfactory to the Administrative Agent, each Lender, and their respective counsel.
350	>
351	> \(c\) **Confidentiality.** This Term Sheet and all of its contents are strictly confidential. Neither this Term Sheet nor any of its terms or the existence of the proposed Facility may be disclosed to any third party (other than the Borrower\'s and the Guarantor\'s officers, directors, employees, legal counsel, accountants, and financial advisors who have a need to know and who have been informed of the confidential nature of this Term Sheet) without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent. Any public announcement or press release relating to the proposed Facility shall require the prior written approval of the Administrative Agent.
352	>
353	> \(d\) **No Fiduciary Duty.** Neither the Administrative Agent, the Lead Arranger, nor any Lender shall have any fiduciary duty or obligation to the Borrower or the Guarantor in connection with this Term Sheet or the transactions contemplated hereby, and each such party is acting solely in its capacity as a lender and/or agent on an arm\'s-length basis.

**[GUARANTY AGREEMENT]{.underline}**

**Dated as of June 2, 2025**

**by**

**TERRAVERDE GROUP, INC.** a Delaware corporation

**as Guarantor**

**in favor of**

**CASCADIA NATIONAL BANK, N.A.** as Administrative Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties

**Senior Secured Revolving Credit Facility** \$275,000,000

**GUARANTY AGREEMENT**

This GUARANTY AGREEMENT (as amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, this \"**Guaranty**\") is made and entered into as of June 2, 2025, by **TERRAVERDE GROUP, INC.**, a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware (the \"**Guarantor**\"), in favor of **CASCADIA NATIONAL BANK, N.A.**, a national banking association, in its capacity as administrative agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the \"**Administrative Agent**\") for the ratable benefit of the Secured Parties (as defined herein).

**[RECITALS]{.underline}**

**A.** Reference is hereby made to that certain Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement, dated as of June 2, 2025 (as may be amended, restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, the \"**Credit Agreement**\"), among Terraverde Industrial Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the \"**Borrower**\"), the Lenders from time to time party thereto (collectively, the \"**Lenders**\"), and Cascadia National Bank, N.A., as Administrative Agent, pursuant to which the Lenders have agreed to make available to the Borrower a \$275,000,000 senior secured revolving credit facility with a term-out option, in each case subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Credit Agreement.

**B.** The Guarantor is the direct parent company of the Borrower and owns, directly and beneficially, one hundred percent (100%) of the issued and outstanding Equity Interests of the Borrower.

**C.** The Guarantor will derive substantial direct and indirect benefit from the extensions of credit made and to be made to the Borrower under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. The credit, financial accommodations, and other benefits flowing to the Borrower under the Credit Agreement will enhance the value of the Guarantor\'s investment in the Borrower and strengthen the overall financial position of the Guarantor and its consolidated subsidiaries.

**D.** It is a condition precedent to the making of the initial Credit Extension under the Credit Agreement that the Guarantor shall have executed and delivered this Guaranty to the Administrative Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties.

**E.** The Guarantor has agreed to execute and deliver this Guaranty in order to induce the Administrative Agent and the Lenders to enter into the Credit Agreement and to make Loans and other extensions of credit to the Borrower thereunder, and the Administrative Agent and the Lenders would not have entered into the Credit Agreement but for the execution and delivery by the Guarantor of this Guaranty.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Guarantor hereby agrees as follows:

**[SECTION 1 --- DEFINITIONS]{.underline}**

**Section 1.1 --- Defined Terms**

As used in this Guaranty, the following terms shall have the meanings set forth below:

\"**Administrative Agent**\" means Cascadia National Bank, N.A., a national banking association, in its capacity as administrative agent for the Secured Parties under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity.

\"**Banking Services Obligations**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Bankruptcy Code**\" means Title 11 of the United States Code, 11 U.S.C. §§ 101 *et seq.*, as amended from time to time, and any successor statute and all rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.

\"**Borrower**\" means Terraverde Industrial Holdings, LLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware.

\"**Business Day**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Collateral**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Credit Agreement**\" means that certain Senior Secured Revolving Credit Agreement, dated as of June 2, 2025, among the Borrower, the Lenders party thereto, and the Administrative Agent, as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time.

\"**Credit Extension**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Default**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Equity Interests**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

\"**Event of Default**\" means any \"Event of Default\" as defined in Section 7.01 of the Credit Agreement.

in each case, whether arising before or after acceleration, whether direct or indirect, absolute or contingent, joint or several, due or to become due, now existing or hereafter arising, and howsoever arising (including, without limitation, under any amendment, supplement, or modification to, or renewal or extension of, the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document). For the avoidance of doubt, no notice of acceleration to the Guarantor shall be required as a condition to the inclusion of any obligation within the definition of \"Guaranteed Obligations.\"

\"**Guarantor**\" means Terraverde Group, Inc., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware.

**Section 1.2 --- Credit Agreement Definitions Incorporated**

**Section 1.3 --- Rules of Interpretation**

**Section 2.1 --- Unconditional Guaranty of Payment and Performance**

The Guarantor hereby unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees to the Administrative Agent, for the ratable benefit of the Secured Parties, the full and punctual payment and performance of all Guaranteed Obligations when due, whether at stated maturity, by required prepayment, by acceleration, by demand, or otherwise, in accordance with the terms of the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Guarantor\'s liability hereunder shall extend to all amounts that would become due but for the operation of the automatic stay imposed under Section 362(a) of the Bankruptcy Code (or any analogous provision under any other applicable law governing insolvency or debtor relief) in connection with any proceeding involving the Borrower or any other person.

This Guaranty is a guaranty of payment and performance and not merely a guaranty of collection. The obligations of the Guarantor under this Guaranty are primary obligations of the Guarantor and are not secondary to or conditioned upon the obligations of the Borrower. The Guarantor agrees that its obligations hereunder are independent of the obligations of the Borrower under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, and that a separate action or actions may be brought and prosecuted against the Guarantor, whether or not any action is brought against the Borrower and whether or not the Borrower is joined in any such action or actions.

**Section 2.2 --- Demand; Immediate Enforceability**

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, or at any time when any Guaranteed Obligation is due and payable (whether at stated maturity, by required prepayment, by acceleration, by demand, or otherwise), the Administrative Agent may make demand upon the Guarantor for the payment or performance of the Guaranteed Obligations, and the Guarantor shall pay or perform the Guaranteed Obligations immediately upon such demand by the Administrative Agent directed to the Guarantor at its notice address set forth in Section 9.1 hereof (or at such other address as the Guarantor may have designated in writing to the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 9.3 hereof).

There shall be no requirement that the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party first make demand upon, or proceed against, or exhaust any remedy against, the Borrower or any other person, or resort to any Collateral or any other security or any other guaranty or any other means of obtaining payment of any of the Guaranteed Obligations, before making demand upon the Guarantor under this Section 2.2. No waiting period, grace period, notice period (other than the demand described in the first sentence of this Section 2.2), or other precondition to enforceability shall apply with respect to demands made upon the Guarantor hereunder. **Section 2.3 --- Unconditional Nature of Obligations**

The obligations of the Guarantor under this Guaranty shall be unconditional, irrespective of:

> \(d\) the taking, exchange, substitution, surrender, release, impairment, or non-perfection of any Collateral or any other security for all or any of the Guaranteed Obligations, or any lack of attachment or deficiency with respect to any such Collateral or security;

> \(f\) any change in the corporate existence, structure, or ownership of the Borrower or any other person liable for the payment or performance of any Guaranteed Obligation, including without limitation any merger, consolidation, reorganization, transfer of assets, dissolution, or winding up;

> \(i\) any impossibility or impracticability of performance, illegality, force majeure, or act of any governmental authority;

> \(j\) any failure of the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party to file or enforce a claim against the Borrower or any other person in any insolvency, bankruptcy, or similar proceeding; or
>
> \(k\) any other circumstance (including, without limitation, any statute of limitations or any existence of or reliance on any representation by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party) or any other manner of administering the Loans or any other Guaranteed Obligation that might otherwise constitute a defense available to, or a legal or equitable discharge of, a surety, guarantor, or co-obligor.

There shall be no limitation or cap on the Guarantor\'s aggregate liability under this Guaranty, and the Guarantor shall be liable for the full amount of the Guaranteed Obligations without deduction, abatement, or offset of any kind or nature whatsoever.

**Section 2.4 --- Liability Absolute**

The Guarantor agrees that its liability hereunder is and shall be absolute and unconditional, and shall not be released, diminished, impaired, reduced, or affected by any of the circumstances described in Section 2.3 hereof or by any other act, omission, matter, or thing whatsoever, whether or not the Guarantor shall have had notice or knowledge thereof. The Guarantor hereby confirms that it is its intention that this Guaranty and the obligations of the Guarantor hereunder shall not be discharged except by the complete and indefeasible payment and performance of the Guaranteed Obligations in accordance with the terms of the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents and the terms of this Guaranty.

**Section 3.1 --- General Waiver of Suretyship Defenses**

The Guarantor hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any and all suretyship defenses and all defenses available to a guarantor or surety under applicable law, including without limitation all defenses, whether legal or equitable, arising under or by reason of suretyship or guaranty law. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Guarantor waives any defense that may arise by reason of (a) the incapacity, disability, lack of authority, death, or dissolution of the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any other person, (b) the failure of the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party to file or enforce a claim against the estate of the Borrower or any other person in any insolvency, bankruptcy, reorganization, or similar proceeding, (c) the election by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party, in any insolvency, bankruptcy, reorganization, or similar proceeding, of the application of Section 1111(b)(2) of the Bankruptcy Code, or (d) any borrowing or grant of a security interest under Section 364 of the Bankruptcy Code.

**Section 3.2 --- Waiver of Right of Marshaling**

The Guarantor hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any right to require the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party to:

> \(a\) proceed against the Borrower or any other person before proceeding against the Guarantor under this Guaranty;
>
> \(b\) proceed against or exhaust any Collateral or any other security held from the Borrower, the Guarantor, or any other person before proceeding against the Guarantor under this Guaranty;

> \(c\) marshal assets or collateral in favor of the Guarantor, the Borrower, or any other person, or to resort to any particular item of Collateral or other security in any particular order or manner; or

**Section 3.3 --- Waiver of Election-of-Remedies Defense**

The Guarantor hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any defense arising from the Administrative Agent\'s or any Secured Party\'s election of remedies, including without limitation any defense based upon an election of remedies by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party that destroys, diminishes, or otherwise adversely affects the Guarantor\'s subrogation rights, the Guarantor\'s rights to proceed against the Borrower for reimbursement, or the Guarantor\'s rights against any other person or any Collateral, even though that election of remedies (such as a nonjudicial foreclosure with respect to any Collateral securing any of the Guaranteed Obligations) operates to impair or destroy any right of reimbursement or subrogation of the Guarantor. The Guarantor hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any defense based on or arising from any applicable statute of limitations or any analogous doctrine in any action or proceeding to enforce this Guaranty or to collect any amount payable hereunder, and the Guarantor agrees that any right of action under this Guaranty, or with respect to any obligation arising hereunder, may be enforced at any time.

Without limiting the generality of the foregoing provisions of this Section 3, the Guarantor hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law:

> \(a\) presentment, demand for payment, protest, notice of protest, notice of dishonor, notice of non-payment, and any other notice or formality required by law to preserve any right against the Guarantor;
>
> \(b\) notice of acceptance of this Guaranty by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party;
>
> \(c\) notice of the creation, renewal, extension, accrual, modification, rearrangement, or amendment of any of the Guaranteed Obligations, and notice of the occurrence of any Default or Event of Default;
>

> \(f\) any and all other notices and demands of any kind or nature whatsoever with respect to the Guaranteed Obligations or this Guaranty.

**Section 3.6 --- Subordination of Subrogation, Contribution, and Reimbursement**

\(a\) Until all Guaranteed Obligations have been indefeasibly paid in full in cash and all commitments under the Credit Agreement have been irrevocably terminated (such conditions being collectively referred to herein as the \"**Termination Conditions**\"), the Guarantor will not exercise and hereby waives any and all rights of subrogation, contribution, reimbursement, indemnification, exoneration, and any other rights of recourse against the Borrower or any other person, or any Collateral or other security, with respect to any payment made or to be made by the Guarantor under this Guaranty, whether such rights arise under an express or implied contract, by operation of law, in equity, or otherwise.

**[SECTION 5 --- CONTINUING GUARANTY; NO TERMINATION]{.underline}**

**Section 5.1 --- Continuing Guaranty**

This Guaranty is a continuing guaranty and shall apply to all Guaranteed Obligations whenever arising. The Guarantor\'s obligations hereunder shall not be affected by any interruption in the business relations of the Borrower, the Guarantor, or the Administrative Agent, or by any intermittent cessation or resumption of borrowings under the Credit Agreement or extensions of credit thereunder. The obligations of the Guarantor under this Guaranty shall extend to any and all Guaranteed Obligations that may arise under any successive amendments, restatements, supplements, or modifications of the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document.

**Section 5.2 --- No Termination**

This Guaranty shall remain in full force and effect until the indefeasible payment in full in cash of all Guaranteed Obligations and the irrevocable termination of all commitments under the Credit Agreement. The Guarantor shall have no right to terminate, revoke, or limit in any manner its obligations under this Guaranty while any Guaranteed Obligation remains outstanding (whether or not due and payable) or while any commitment under the Credit Agreement remains in effect or capable of being reinstated.

This Guaranty shall continue to be effective or be reinstated, as the case may be, if at any time any amount received by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party in respect of the Guaranteed Obligations is required to be restored or returned for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation as contemplated by Section 4.1 hereof. In the event of any such restoration or return, all rights and obligations of the Guarantor hereunder shall be reinstated and thereafter continue in full force and effect as if such payment had not been received by the Administrative Agent or such Secured Party.

**[SECTION 6 --- REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES]{.underline}**

The Guarantor hereby represents and warrants to the Administrative Agent and each Secured Party as of the date hereof as follows:

**Section 6.1 --- Existence and Power**

The Guarantor is a corporation duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of the State of Delaware. The Guarantor has all corporate power and authority necessary to own and operate its properties, to carry on its business as currently conducted, and to execute, deliver, and perform its obligations under this Guaranty. The Guarantor is duly qualified to do business and is in good standing in each jurisdiction in which the character of its properties or the nature of its business requires such qualification, except where the failure to be so qualified or in good standing could not reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the Guarantor\'s ability to perform its obligations under this Guaranty.

**Section 6.2 --- Authorization; No Contravention**

The execution, delivery, and performance by the Guarantor of this Guaranty have been duly authorized by all necessary corporate action on the part of the Guarantor, including all necessary action by its board of directors. The execution, delivery, and performance by the Guarantor of this Guaranty do not and will not (a) violate the certificate of incorporation, bylaws, or other organizational documents of the Guarantor, (b) violate any applicable law, rule, regulation, order, writ, judgment, injunction, decree, determination, or award to which the Guarantor or any of its properties or assets is subject, (c) result in a breach of, constitute a default under, or result in the creation or imposition of any lien or encumbrance upon any property or assets of the Guarantor pursuant to, any material indenture, agreement, or other instrument to which the Guarantor is a party or by which the Guarantor or any of its properties or assets may be bound or affected, or (d) require any consent, approval, or authorization of, or filing, registration, or qualification with, any governmental authority or any other person, except as contemplated by Section 6.3 hereof.

**Section 6.3 --- Governmental Authorization**

No approval, authorization, consent, license, permit, order, or filing of, with, or to any governmental authority is required in connection with the execution, delivery, performance, validity, or enforceability of this Guaranty, other than those that have been duly obtained or made and are in full force and effect as of the date hereof.

**Section 6.4 --- Binding Effect**

This Guaranty constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of the Guarantor, enforceable against the Guarantor in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, fraudulent transfer, and other similar laws affecting creditors\' rights generally, and subject, as to enforceability, to general principles of equity (regardless of whether enforcement is sought in a proceeding in equity or at law).

**Section 6.5 --- Solvency**

After giving effect to the transactions contemplated by the Credit Agreement and this Guaranty, and after giving effect to the initial Credit Extensions to be made under the Credit Agreement on the date hereof, the Guarantor is solvent and will not be rendered insolvent by the execution, delivery, or performance of this Guaranty. As of the date hereof, (a) the fair value of the assets of the Guarantor exceeds the total amount of its liabilities (including contingent and unliquidated liabilities), (b) the present fair salable value of the assets of the Guarantor is greater than the amount that will be required to pay the probable liability on the Guarantor\'s debts and other liabilities (including contingent and unliquidated liabilities) as they become absolute and matured, (c) the Guarantor is able to realize upon its assets and pay its debts and other liabilities (including contingent and unliquidated liabilities) as they mature in the normal course of business, (d) the Guarantor does not intend to, and does not believe that it will, incur debts or liabilities beyond its ability to pay as such debts and liabilities mature, and (e) the Guarantor is not engaged in business or a transaction, and is not about to engage in business or a transaction, for which the Guarantor\'s property would constitute unreasonably small capital.

**Section 6.6 --- Benefit**

The Guarantor has received, or will receive, direct or indirect benefit from the making of the extensions of credit under the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. The Guarantor has established adequate means of obtaining from the Borrower, on a continuing basis, information pertaining to the business, operations, condition (financial and otherwise), properties, assets, and prospects of the Borrower, and the Guarantor hereby acknowledges and agrees that it is not relying on the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party to provide any such information to the Guarantor, either now or in the future.

**[SECTION 7 --- COVENANTS]{.underline}**

The Guarantor shall (a) comply in all material respects with all laws, rules, regulations, orders, writs, judgments, injunctions, decrees, and awards to which the Guarantor is subject, except where the failure to so comply could not reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the Guarantor\'s ability to perform its obligations under this Guaranty, and (b) maintain its corporate existence, good standing, and qualification to do business in each jurisdiction in which the character of its properties or the nature of its business requires such qualification, except where the failure to maintain such existence, good standing, or qualification could not reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the Guarantor\'s ability to perform its obligations under this Guaranty.

**Section 7.2 --- Notices**

**Section 7.3 --- Further Assurances**

The Guarantor shall, at its own cost and expense, execute and deliver such further instruments, agreements, certificates, and documents, and take such further actions, as the Administrative Agent may from time to time reasonably request to carry out the intent and purposes of this Guaranty and to protect, preserve, and enforce the rights and remedies of the Administrative Agent and the Secured Parties under this Guaranty. The Guarantor shall cooperate fully with the Administrative Agent in connection with any action or proceeding taken or to be taken for the purpose of enforcing this Guaranty or collecting any amounts due or to become due hereunder.

**[SECTION 8 --- SUBORDINATION OF OTHER INDEBTEDNESS]{.underline}**

**Section 8.1 --- Full Subordination**

All indebtedness, liabilities, and obligations now or hereafter owed by the Borrower to the Guarantor, whether for principal, interest, fees, expenses, or otherwise, and whether arising by reason of any loan, advance, guaranty, indemnification, equity contribution, capital contribution, tax-sharing arrangement, management fee arrangement, services arrangement, or any other transaction, contract, or arrangement of any kind or nature whatsoever (collectively, \"**Intercompany Indebtedness**\"), is hereby subordinated in right of payment to the prior indefeasible payment in full in cash of all Guaranteed Obligations. No threshold, basket, minimum amount, or de minimis exception applies to such subordination; all Intercompany Indebtedness of every type, kind, and amount is fully subordinated to the Guaranteed Obligations.

**Section 8.2 --- Payment Restriction**

Until all Guaranteed Obligations have been indefeasibly paid in full in cash and all commitments under the Credit Agreement have been irrevocably terminated, the Guarantor shall not demand, accept, receive, collect, or otherwise obtain any payment or satisfaction of any kind or nature (whether in cash, property, by set-off, or otherwise) in respect of any Intercompany Indebtedness at any time:

> \(a\) during the existence of any Default or Event of Default under the Credit Agreement;
>
> \(b\) at any time when the Administrative Agent shall have delivered a written notice to the Guarantor directing that such payments shall not be made (a \"**Payment Blockage Notice**\"); or
>
> \(c\) at all other times during the term of this Guaranty, unless such payment is expressly permitted under the Credit Agreement and no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or would result from such payment.

The restriction on payment of Intercompany Indebtedness set forth in this Section 8.2 is intended to apply at all times (and not only during the continuance of an Event of Default) to the fullest extent consistent with the terms of the Credit Agreement.

**Section 8.3 --- Trust for Benefit of Secured Parties**

If the Guarantor shall receive any payment, distribution, or other value in respect of any Intercompany Indebtedness in violation of Section 8.2 hereof, such payment, distribution, or other value shall be received and held by the Guarantor in trust for the benefit of the Administrative Agent and the Secured Parties, shall be segregated from other funds and property of the Guarantor, and shall be forthwith and without demand paid or delivered to the Administrative Agent in the form received (duly endorsed or assigned as may be necessary) for application to the Guaranteed Obligations, whether matured or unmatured, in such order and in such manner as the Administrative Agent shall determine in its sole discretion. Each such notice or communication shall be deemed to have been duly given or made and to have become effective (i) if delivered by hand, at the time of receipt by the addressee, (ii) if sent by nationally recognized overnight courier service, on the first Business Day following the date of deposit with such courier service, and (iii) if sent by email, upon transmission and electronic confirmation of receipt (or, if transmitted after 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a Business Day or on a day that is not a Business Day, on the next succeeding Business Day). Either party hereto may change its address, facsimile number, or email address for notices and other communications by providing written notice thereof to the other party in accordance with the provisions of this Section 9.3.

**[SECTION 10 --- GOVERNING LAW; JURISDICTION; JURY TRIAL WAIVER]{.underline}**

**Section 10.1 --- Governing Law**

THIS GUARANTY AND THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES HEREUNDER SHALL BE GOVERNED BY, AND CONSTRUED AND INTERPRETED IN ACCORDANCE WITH, THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK, WITHOUT REGARD TO PRINCIPLES OF CONFLICTS OF LAWS THAT WOULD CAUSE THE APPLICATION OF THE LAWS OF ANY OTHER JURISDICTION (OTHER THAN SECTION 5-1401 AND SECTION 5-1402 OF THE NEW YORK GENERAL OBLIGATIONS LAW).

**Section 10.2 --- Submission to Jurisdiction**

The Guarantor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally submits, for itself and its property, to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the State of New York sitting in the Borough of Manhattan, the City of New York, and the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York, and any appellate court from any thereof, in any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Guaranty, the other Loan Documents, or the transactions contemplated hereby or thereby, or for recognition or enforcement of any judgment, and each of the Guarantor and the Administrative Agent hereby irrevocably and unconditionally agrees that all claims in respect of any such action or proceeding may be heard and determined in such New York State court or, to the extent permitted by applicable law, in such United States Federal court. The Guarantor hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives, to the fullest extent it may legally and effectively do so, any objection that it may now or hereafter have to the laying of venue of any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Guaranty or any other Loan Document in any such court, and any defense of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding in any such court. Nothing in this Section 10.2 shall affect the right of the Administrative Agent to serve process in any manner permitted by applicable law.

**Section 10.3 --- Service of Process**

The Guarantor irrevocably consents to service of process in the manner provided for notices in Section 9. Nothing in this Guaranty will affect the right of any party hereto to serve process in any other manner permitted by applicable law. The Guarantor further irrevocably consents to service of process by mail directed to the Guarantor at its address set forth in Section 9.1 hereof (or at such other address as the Guarantor may have designated in writing to the Administrative Agent in accordance with Section 9.3 hereof). Service so made shall be deemed completed upon the earlier of actual receipt or three (3) Business Days after deposit in the United States mail, postage prepaid, registered or certified, return receipt requested.

**Section 10.4 --- Waiver of Jury Trial**

EACH OF THE GUARANTOR AND THE ADMINISTRATIVE AGENT (ON BEHALF OF ITSELF AND EACH SECURED PARTY) HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ANY AND ALL RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL PROCEEDING DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS GUARANTY AGREEMENT, THE CREDIT AGREEMENT, ANY OTHER LOAN DOCUMENT, OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY OR THEREBY (WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT, TORT, OR ANY OTHER THEORY). EACH OF THE GUARANTOR AND THE ADMINISTRATIVE AGENT (A) CERTIFIES THAT NO REPRESENTATIVE, AGENT, OR ATTORNEY OF ANY OTHER PERSON HAS REPRESENTED, EXPRESSLY OR OTHERWISE, THAT SUCH OTHER PERSON WOULD NOT, IN THE EVENT OF LITIGATION, SEEK TO ENFORCE THE FOREGOING WAIVER AND (B) ACKNOWLEDGES THAT IT AND THE OTHER PARTIES HERETO HAVE BEEN INDUCED TO ENTER INTO THIS GUARANTY AND THE OTHER LOAN DOCUMENTS BY, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE MUTUAL WAIVERS AND CERTIFICATIONS IN THIS SECTION 10.4. THIS WAIVER IS CONSISTENT WITH AND SHALL BE CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH SECTION 9.15 OF THE CREDIT AGREEMENT.

**[SECTION 11 --- AMENDMENTS]{.underline}**

**Section 11.1 --- Amendments and Waivers**

No amendment, modification, termination, or waiver of any provision of this Guaranty, and no consent to any departure by the Guarantor therefrom, shall in any event be effective unless the same shall be in writing and signed by the Administrative Agent acting at the direction of the Required Lenders (or, in the case of any amendment, modification, termination, or waiver that, pursuant to Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement, requires the consent of all Lenders, at the direction of all of the Lenders), and then such waiver or consent shall be effective only in the specific instance and for the specific purpose for which given.

No consent of the Guarantor shall be required for any amendment, modification, supplement, waiver, or consent to this Guaranty made by the Administrative Agent acting at the direction of the Required Lenders (or all Lenders, as applicable) in accordance with this Section 11.1.

For the avoidance of doubt, and consistent with Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement, the unanimous consent of all Lenders shall be required for (a) the release of the Guarantor from this Guaranty (except as otherwise provided in the Credit Agreement in connection with a transaction permitted thereunder), (b) any amendment or modification that would limit the scope or reduce the amount of the Guaranteed Obligations, or (c) any other amendment, modification, or waiver that, under Section 9.01 of the Credit Agreement, requires the consent of all Lenders with respect to this Guaranty or any similar guaranty.

**[SECTION 12 --- MISCELLANEOUS]{.underline}**

**Section 12.1 --- Successors and Assigns**

This Guaranty shall be binding upon the Guarantor and its successors and assigns and shall inure to the benefit of the Administrative Agent, each Secured Party, and their respective successors, transferees, and permitted assigns. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, any Lender may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under the Credit Agreement in accordance with Section 9.04 of the Credit Agreement, and the assignee or transferee thereof shall thereupon become vested with all the benefits in respect thereof granted to such Lender herein or otherwise. The Guarantor may not assign, delegate, or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Guaranty without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent (acting at the direction of the Required Lenders), and any attempted assignment, delegation, or transfer without such consent shall be null and void.

**Section 12.2 --- No Waiver; Cumulative Remedies**

No failure or delay by the Administrative Agent or any Secured Party in exercising any right, remedy, power, or privilege hereunder or under any other Loan Document shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any such right, remedy, power, or privilege preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power, or privilege. The rights, remedies, powers, and privileges herein provided are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights, remedies, powers, or privileges provided by applicable law or in any other Loan Document.

**Section 12.3 --- Severability**

If any provision of this Guaranty is held to be illegal, invalid, or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, (a) the legality, validity, and enforceability of the remaining provisions of this Guaranty shall not be affected or impaired thereby, and (b) the parties shall endeavor in good faith negotiations to replace the illegal, invalid, or unenforceable provision with a valid provision that is as similar to the original provision as possible and that, to the greatest extent possible, carries out the intent and purpose of the illegal, invalid, or unenforceable provision. The invalidity of a provision in any jurisdiction shall not invalidate or render unenforceable such provision in any other jurisdiction.

**Section 12.4 --- Entire Agreement**

This Guaranty, together with the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, constitutes the entire agreement of the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, representations, and warranties, whether written or oral, between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof.

**Section 12.5 --- Counterparts**

This Guaranty may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when so executed and delivered shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page of this Guaranty by facsimile transmission or by email with a PDF attachment or other electronic imaging means shall be effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart of this Guaranty. Electronic signatures (including those delivered by DocuSign or similar platforms) shall be deemed to be original signatures for all purposes and shall be binding upon the parties hereto.

**Section 12.6 --- Headings**

Section headings and the table of contents, if any, used in this Guaranty are included for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the construction or interpretation of any provision of this Guaranty.

208	With reference to this Agreement and each other Loan Document, unless otherwise specified herein or therein: (a) the meanings of defined terms are equally applicable to singular and plural forms; (b) the words “include,” “includes” and “including” are deemed to be followed by “without limitation”; (c) references to agreements include all amendments and supplements permitted by the Loan Documents; (d) references to any Person include its successors and permitted assigns; (e) references to articles, sections, schedules and exhibits are to this Agreement; and (f) the word “or” is not exclusive. All references to time are to New York City time unless otherwise stated. All monetary amounts are expressed in U.S. Dollars.
209	
210	Section 1.03 — Accounting Terms
211	
212	All accounting terms not specifically defined herein shall be construed in accordance with GAAP as in effect on the Closing Date. If at any time any change in GAAP would affect the computation of any financial ratio or requirement set forth herein, the Borrower and the Administrative Agent shall negotiate in good faith to amend such ratio or requirement to preserve the original intent thereof; until so amended, such computations shall continue to be made using GAAP as in effect on the Closing Date.
213	
214	Section 1.04 — Rounding; Exchange Rates
215	
216	Financial ratios required to be maintained by the Borrower shall be calculated by dividing the appropriate component by the other component, carrying the result to one decimal place more than the number of decimal places by which such ratio is expressed herein, and rounding upward or downward to the nearest number. If any amount is denominated in a currency other than U.S. Dollars, the Administrative Agent may determine the U.S. Dollar equivalent using customary market exchange rates.
217	
218	Section 1.05 — Times of Day
219	
220	Unless otherwise specified, all references to times of day shall be references to New York City time.
221	
222	Section 1.06 — Letter of Credit Amounts
223	
224	Unless otherwise specified, the amount of a Letter of Credit at any time shall be the stated amount then in effect, after giving effect to all increases, decreases, reinstatements and drawings.
225	
226	ARTICLE II — THE CREDITS
227	
228	Section 2.01 — Revolving Commitments
229	
230	Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, each Lender severally agrees to make Revolving Credit Loans to the Borrower from time to time during the Commitment Period in an aggregate principal amount that will not result in such Lender’s Revolving Credit Exposure exceeding such Lender’s Revolving Commitment or the total Revolving Credit Exposures exceeding the Aggregate Commitments. The Aggregate Commitments as of the Closing Date are $275,000,000. Within the foregoing limits and subject to the terms and conditions hereof, the Borrower may borrow, repay and reborrow Revolving Credit Loans during the Commitment Period. Schedule 2.01 sets forth each Lender’s individual Revolving Commitment and Pro Rata Share.
231	
232	Section 2.02 — Borrowings, Conversions, and Continuations
233	
234	Each Revolving Credit Borrowing shall be made upon the Borrower’s irrevocable notice to the Administrative Agent in the form of a Borrowing Request. Each Borrowing Request shall specify the requested date of borrowing, the aggregate amount requested, whether the borrowing is to consist of Base Rate Loans or Term SOFR Loans, and, for Term SOFR Loans, the applicable Interest Period.
235	
236	Borrowing Requests for Base Rate Loans shall be delivered not later than 11:00 a.m. on the requested borrowing date. Borrowing Requests for Term SOFR Loans shall be delivered not later than 11:00 a.m. three U.S. Government Securities Business Days before the requested borrowing date.
237	
238	Each Base Rate Borrowing shall be in a minimum amount of $1,000,000 and integral multiples of $500,000 in excess thereof. Each Term SOFR Borrowing shall be in a minimum amount of $5,000,000 and integral multiples of $1,000,000 in excess thereof.
239	
240	The Borrower may elect to convert Loans from one interest rate type to another or continue Term SOFR Loans for an additional Interest Period by delivering a notice of conversion or continuation to the Administrative Agent. If the Borrower fails timely to continue a Term SOFR Loan, such Loan shall convert to a Base Rate Loan at the end of the then-current Interest Period.
241	
242	Section 2.03 — Letters of Credit
243	
244	Subject to the terms and conditions hereof, each L/C Issuer agrees to issue standby and commercial Letters of Credit for the account of the Borrower during the Commitment Period, provided that the aggregate L/C Obligations shall not exceed the L/C Sublimit and no Lender’s Revolving Credit Exposure shall exceed its Revolving Commitment.
245	
246	The Borrower shall request each Letter of Credit by delivering an application in the applicable L/C Issuer’s standard form at least three Business Days before the requested issuance date. Each Letter of Credit shall expire no later than the earlier of one year after issuance and five Business Days prior to the Revolving Termination Date, unless otherwise agreed by the applicable L/C Issuer and the Administrative Agent.
247	
248	Upon issuance of any Letter of Credit, each Lender shall be deemed to have purchased a participation therein equal to its Pro Rata Share. The Borrower shall reimburse any drawing under a Letter of Credit on the date such drawing is paid. If the Borrower fails to reimburse such drawing, the unreimbursed amount shall be deemed a Base Rate Loan.
249	
250	Section 2.04 — Term-Out Option
251	
252	The Borrower may make a Term-Out Election no earlier than 180 days prior to the Revolving Termination Date and no later than the Revolving Termination Date, by delivering to the Administrative Agent a Term-Out Election Notice substantially in the form of Exhibit E. Such election shall be irrevocable and shall specify the amount of outstanding Revolving Credit Loans to be converted into Term Loans.
253	
254	Each Term Loan shall amortize in equal quarterly installments in an aggregate annual amount equal to 10.00% of the original principal amount of such Term Loan for each of the first two years following the Term-Out Election and 15.00% of such original principal amount during the third year, with the remaining balance due on the Term Loan Maturity Date. Amounts repaid or prepaid in respect of Term Loans may not be reborrowed.
255	
256	Term Loans shall bear interest, at the Borrower’s option, as Base Rate Loans or Term SOFR Loans, at the rate otherwise applicable to Revolving Credit Loans plus 0.25% per annum. The conversion of Revolving Credit Loans to Term Loans shall not constitute a new advance of credit.
257	
258	Section 2.05 — Swing Line Loans
259	
260	Subject to the terms hereof, the Swing Line Lender may, in its discretion, make Swing Line Loans to the Borrower in an aggregate principal amount not exceeding the Swing Line Sublimit. Swing Line Loans shall be Base Rate Loans and shall be payable on demand, but in any event not later than the Revolving Termination Date.
261	
262	The Borrower may request a Swing Line Loan by notice to the Swing Line Lender and the Administrative Agent not later than 1:00 p.m. on the requested borrowing date. Each Swing Line Loan shall be in a minimum amount of $250,000 and integral multiples of $100,000. Each Lender shall acquire an irrevocable participation in each Swing Line Loan equal to its Pro Rata Share.
263	
264	Section 2.06 — Prepayments
265	
266	The Borrower may voluntarily prepay Loans in whole or in part upon notice to the Administrative Agent. Prepayments of Base Rate Loans shall be in minimum amounts of $1,000,000 and prepayments of Term SOFR Loans shall be in minimum amounts of $5,000,000, or, in each case, the remaining principal amount outstanding if less.
267	
268	The Borrower shall make mandatory prepayments: (a) if the Revolving Credit Exposures exceed the Aggregate Commitments, in the amount of such excess; (b) upon any reduction of Commitments to the extent necessary to eliminate any excess exposure; and (c) from net cash proceeds of asset sales not reinvested within 180 days, in an amount equal to 100% of such unreinvested proceeds, subject to ordinary course and de minimis exceptions approved by the Administrative Agent.
269	
270	Mandatory prepayments shall be applied first to Swing Line Loans, second to Revolving Credit Loans, third to cash collateralize L/C Obligations, and fourth, after a Term-Out Election, to Term Loans in inverse order of maturity unless otherwise directed by the Required Lenders.
271	
272	Section 2.07 — Reduction and Termination of Commitments
273	
274	The Borrower may permanently reduce or terminate the Revolving Commitments upon at least three Business Days’ notice to the Administrative Agent. Each partial reduction shall be in a minimum amount of $5,000,000 and integral multiples of $1,000,000. Any reduction shall be applied ratably among the Lenders. The Revolving Commitments shall automatically terminate on the Revolving Termination Date.
275	
276	Section 2.08 — Repayment of Loans
277	
278	The Borrower shall repay all outstanding Revolving Credit Loans on the Revolving Termination Date, except to the extent converted to Term Loans pursuant to a valid Term-Out Election. The Borrower shall repay Term Loans in accordance with the amortization schedule set forth in Section 2.04 and shall repay all remaining principal, interest and other amounts owing in respect thereof on the applicable Term Loan Maturity Date.
279	
280	Section 2.09 — Interest
281	
282	Base Rate Loans shall bear interest at the Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate. Term SOFR Loans shall bear interest at Adjusted Term SOFR for the applicable Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate.
283	
284	Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, at the request of the Required Lenders, all outstanding Obligations shall bear interest at a rate equal to 2.00% per annum above the rate otherwise applicable thereto. Overdue interest, fees and other amounts shall bear interest at the Base Rate
