on 2.08 — Repayment of Loans

The Borrower shall repay all outstanding Revolving Credit Loans on the Revolving Termination Date, except to the extent converted to Term Loans pursuant to a valid Term-Out Election. The Borrower shall repay Term Loans in accordance with the amortization schedule set forth in Section 2.04 and shall repay all remaining principal, interest and other amounts owing in respect thereof on the applicable Term Loan Maturity Date.

Section 2.09 — Interest

Base Rate Loans shall bear interest at the Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate. Term SOFR Loans shall bear interest at Adjusted Term SOFR for the applicable Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate.

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, at the request of the Required Lenders, all outstanding Obligations shall bear interest at a rate equal to 2.00% per annum above the rate otherwise applicable thereto. Overdue interest, fees and other amounts shall bear interest at the Base Rate plus the Applicable Rate for Base Rate Loans plus 2.00% per annum.

Interest on Base Rate Loans shall be payable quarterly in arrears. Interest on Term SOFR Loans shall be payable on the last day of each Interest Period and, for Interest Periods longer than three months, every three months after the commencement thereof.

Section 2.10 — Fees

The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the account of each Lender, a commitment fee equal to the Applicable Rate for commitment fees multiplied by the daily unused amount of such Lender’s Revolving Commitment. Such fee shall accrue from the Closing Date to the Revolving Termination Date and shall be payable quarterly in arrears.

The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent, for the account of each Lender, a Letter of Credit participation fee equal to the Applicable Rate for Term SOFR Loans multiplied by such Lender’s Pro Rata Share of the daily stated amount of outstanding Letters of Credit. The Borrower shall also pay to each L/C Issuer a fronting fee equal to 0.125% per annum of the daily stated amount of Letters of Credit issued by such L/C Issuer, plus customary issuance, amendment and processing charges.

The Borrower shall pay to the Administrative Agent such administrative agent fees as are separately agreed in the fee letter between the Borrower and the Administrative Agent.

Section 2.11 — Computation of Interest and Fees

Interest on Base Rate Loans calculated by reference to the prime rate shall be computed on the basis of a 365- or 366-day year, as applicable, and actual days elapsed. All other interest and fees shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day year and actual days elapsed.

Section 2.12 — Evidence of Indebtedness

Each Lender shall maintain records evidencing the indebtedness of the Borrower to such Lender. The entries made in such records shall be prima facie evidence of the existence and amounts of the obligations recorded therein, absent manifest error. Upon request by any Lender, the Borrower shall execute and deliver to such Lender a Note substantially in the form of Exhibit B.

Section 2.13 — Payments Generally; Administrative Agent’s Clawback

All payments by the Borrower shall be made in U.S. Dollars, in immediately available funds, without setoff, counterclaim or deduction, to the Administrative Agent at 900 SW Morrison Street, Suite 2200, Portland, Oregon 97205, or to such account as the Administrative Agent may designate, not later than 12:00 noon on the date due.

If the Administrative Agent makes any payment to a Lender in expectation that a corresponding payment will be received from the Borrower and such payment is not received, such Lender shall repay the amount to the Administrative Agent on demand. Payments received by the Administrative Agent shall be applied and distributed ratably among the Lenders according to their respective interests unless otherwise expressly provided herein.

Section 2.14 — Extension of Revolving Termination Date

The Borrower may, once during each calendar year, request an extension of the Revolving Termination Date by one year by delivering notice to the Administrative Agent not earlier than 90 days and not later than 45 days prior to an anniversary of the Closing Date. Each Lender may approve or decline such request in its sole discretion. The Revolving Termination Date shall be extended only as to approving Lenders and only upon satisfaction of conditions reasonably required by the Administrative Agent, including no Default or Event of Default and payment of applicable extension fees.

Section 2.15 — Incremental Facilities

The Borrower may request increases to the Aggregate Commitments in an aggregate amount not exceeding $75,000,000, subject to the consent of the Administrative Agent and each increasing or additional Lender, no Default or Event of Default, pro forma compliance with Section 6.10, and execution of documentation reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent. No Lender shall be obligated to increase its Revolving Commitment.

ARTICLE III — CONDITIONS PRECEDENT

Section 3.01 — Conditions to Closing Date and Initial Credit Extension

The effectiveness of this Agreement and the obligation of each Lender to make its initial Credit Extension are subject to satisfaction or waiver of the following conditions:

1. The Administrative Agent shall have received executed counterparts of this Agreement, the Guaranty, the Security Documents and the other Loan Documents required on the Closing Date.

2. The Administrative Agent shall have received legal opinions, in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to it, including:

(a) an opinion of Whitfield Crane & Sadler LLP, counsel to the Administrative Agent, as to customary matters;

(b) an opinion of Marchetti DeLuca LLP, counsel to the Borrower and the Guarantor, or other counsel reasonably acceptable to the Administrative Agent, addressing due authorization, execution and delivery, enforceability of the Loan Documents, including the Guaranty, against each Loan Party, no conflicts, and such other matters as the Administrative Agent shall reasonably request, subject to customary assumptions, qualifications and exceptions; and

(c) an opinion of Delaware counsel to the Guarantor as to corporate existence, good standing, due authorization and enforceability under Delaware law.

3. The Administrative Agent shall have received officer’s certificates of each Loan Party, including incumbency certificates, organizational documents and authorizing resolutions.

4. The Administrative Agent shall have received evidence of perfection of security interests, including UCC financing statements, control agreements where required, and mortgage or fixture filings where applicable.

5. The Administrative Agent shall have received recent lien searches in jurisdictions reasonably requested by it.

6. The Administrative Agent shall have received insurance certificates naming the Administrative Agent as lender loss payee and additional insured, as applicable.

7. The Administrative Agent shall have received financial statements for the Borrower and Guarantor, including the most recent audited annual and unaudited interim financial statements.

8. All fees and expenses due on or before the Closing Date, including fees and disbursements of Whitfield Crane & Sadler LLP, shall have been paid.

9. No Default or Event of Default shall exist.

10. Since December 31, 2024, no Material Adverse Effect shall have occurred.

Section 3.02 — Conditions to Each Credit Extension

The obligation of each Lender, Swing Line Lender and L/C Issuer to make any Credit Extension is subject to the following conditions:

1. The representations and warranties of the Loan Parties set forth in the Loan Documents shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the date of such Credit Extension, except to the extent expressly made as of an earlier date.

2. No Default or Event of Default shall exist or would result from such Credit Extension.

3. The Administrative Agent shall have received a Borrowing Request, Swing Line request or L/C Application, as applicable.

Each Credit Extension shall be deemed a representation by the Borrower that the conditions in this Section 3.02 have been satisfied.

ARTICLE IV — REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

The Borrower represents and warrants to the Administrative Agent and each Lender as follows.

Section 4.01 — Existence; Qualification; Power

The Borrower is a limited liability company duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Delaware. Each Loan Party has all requisite power and authority to own its properties, conduct its business and execute, deliver and perform its obligations under the Loan Documents.

Section 4.02 — Authorization; No Contravention

The execution, delivery and performance by each Loan Party of the Loan Documents have been duly authorized by all necessary organizational action and do not contravene the organizational documents of such Loan Party, any material contract or any applicable law.

Section 4.03 — Governmental Authorization; Other Consents

No governmental approval or third-party consent is required in connection with the execution, delivery or performance of the Loan Documents, except approvals and consents that have been obtained and are in full force and effect.

Section 4.04 — Binding Effect

This Agreement and each other Loan Document constitute legal, valid and binding obligations of each Loan Party party thereto, enforceable against such Loan Party in accordance with their terms, subject to bankruptcy, insolvency and similar laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and general principles of equity.

Section 4.05 — Financial Statements; No Material Adverse Effect

The financial statements delivered to the Administrative Agent fairly present in all material respects the financial condition and results of operations of the Borrower and Guarantor for the periods covered thereby. Since December 31, 2024, there has been no Material Adverse Effect.

Section 4.06 — Litigation

Except as disclosed on Schedule 4.06, there is no action, suit, investigation or proceeding pending or, to the Borrower’s knowledge, threatened against any Loan Party that could reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

Section 4.07 — No Default

No Default or Event of Default exists or would result from the consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Loan Documents.

Section 4.08 — Ownership of Property; Liens

Each Loan Party has good title to, or valid leasehold interests in, its material properties, subject only to Permitted Liens. The Security Documents create valid and perfected Liens in the Collateral described therein, subject to Permitted Liens.

Section 4.09 — Environmental Compliance

The Borrower and its Subsidiaries are in compliance with Environmental Laws except where noncompliance could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. No Loan Party has received written notice of any material Environmental Law violation that remains unresolved.

Section 4.10 — Taxes

Each Loan Party has filed all material tax returns required to be filed and has paid all material taxes due, except those being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings and for which adequate reserves have been established.

Section 4.11 — ERISA Compliance

Each employee benefit plan maintained by any Loan Party complies in all material respects with ERISA and the Internal Revenue Code. No ERISA event has occurred that could reasonably be expected to result in liability exceeding $10,000,000.

Section 4.12 — Subsidiaries; Equity Interests

Schedule 4.12 accurately sets forth the Subsidiaries and Equity Interests of the Borrower. The Guarantor owns 100% of the Equity Interests in the Borrower free and clear of all Liens other than Liens in favor of the Administrative Agent.

Section 4.13 — Margin Regulations

The Borrower is not engaged principally in the business of extending credit for purchasing or carrying margin stock, and no proceeds of any Loan will be used in violation of Regulation U or Regulation X of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.

Section 4.14 — Intellectual Property

The Borrower and its Subsidiaries own or have the right to use all intellectual property necessary for the conduct of their businesses, except where failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

Section 4.15 — Solvency

After giving effect to the transactions contemplated hereby, the Borrower and the Loan Parties, on a consolidated basis, are Solvent.

Section 4.16 — Swap Obligations

The Borrower has entered or may enter into Swap Contracts with one or more Swap Counterparties. All obligations of the Borrower under such Swap Contracts constitute Obligations secured by the Security Documents and guaranteed under the Guaranty, subject to applicable law, including the Commodity Exchange Act.

Section 4.17 — Anti-Corruption; Sanctions

No Loan Party, nor to the knowledge of the Borrower any director, officer or employee thereof, is a Sanctioned Person or has violated any Anti-Corruption Laws or Sanctions in any material respect. The Borrower maintains policies and procedures reasonably designed to promote compliance with Anti-Corruption Laws and Sanctions.

Section 4.18 — Eligible Contract Participant Status

The Borrower is, and will be at the time it enters into each Swap Contract, an Eligible Contract Participant with respect to such Swap Contract.

ARTICLE V — AFFIRMATIVE COVENANTS

Until the Obligations are paid in full and the Commitments have terminated, the Borrower shall:

Section 5.01 — Financial Statements

Deliver to the Administrative Agent: (a) within 90 days after each fiscal year, audited consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor and its Subsidiaries; and (b) within 45 days after each of the first three fiscal quarters, unaudited consolidated financial statements of the Guarantor and its Subsidiaries.

Section 5.02 — Certificates; Other Information

Deliver with each set of financial statements a Compliance Certificate executed by a responsible officer of the Borrower. The Borrower shall also deliver such other financial, operational or collateral information as the Administrative Agent may reasonably request.

Section 5.03 — Notices

Promptly notify the Administrative Agent of: (a) any Default or Event of Default; (b) any event that has resulted in or could reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect; (c) material litigation; (d) material ERISA events; and (e) material notices received under Environmental Laws.

Section 5.04 — Payment of Obligations

Pay and discharge all material taxes, assessments and governmental charges before delinquency, except those contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings and for which adequate reserves are maintained.

Section 5.05 — Preservation of Existence

Preserve and maintain its legal existence, good standing and rights, franchises, permits and licenses material to its business, except as otherwise permitted by Section 6.03.

Section 5.06 — Maintenance of Properties

Maintain all material properties necessary to its business in good working order and condition, ordinary wear and tear excepted.

Section 5.07 — Maintenance of Insurance

Maintain insurance with financially sound insurers in such amounts and against such risks as are customarily maintained by similarly situated companies, naming the Administrative Agent as lender loss payee or additional insured, as applicable.

Section 5.08 — Compliance with Laws

Comply with all applicable laws, including Anti-Corruption Laws, Sanctions, Environmental Laws and ERISA, except where failure to comply could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

Section 5.09 — Books and Records; Inspection

Maintain proper books and records in accordance with GAAP and permit representatives of the Administrative Agent, upon reasonable notice, to inspect properties, examine records and discuss affairs with officers and independent accountants during normal business hours.

Section 5.10 — Use of Proceeds

Use the proceeds of Loans for working capital, capital expenditures, permitted acquisitions, refinancing of existing indebtedness and other lawful corporate purposes. No proceeds shall be used in violation of Anti-Corruption Laws, Sanctions or margin regulations.

Section 5.11 — Additional Guarantors / Collateral

Cause any material Subsidiary formed or acquired after the Closing Date, if required by the Administrative Agent, to become a guarantor and grant security interests in its assets by executing joinders and security documents reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent.

Section 5.12 — Compliance with Environmental Laws

Conduct its business in compliance with Environmental Laws and promptly remediate environmental conditions as required by law, except where failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect.

Section 5.13 — Further Assurances

Execute and deliver such additional documents and take such actions as the Administrative Agent may reasonably request to perfect, maintain and protect the Liens granted under the Security Documents and to carry out the purposes of the Loan Documents.

ARTICLE VI — NEGATIVE COVENANTS

Until the Obligations are paid in full and the Commitments have terminated, the Borrower shall not:

Section 6.01 — Indebtedness

Create, incur or permit Indebtedness except: (a) Obligations under the Loan Documents; (b) Indebtedness listed on Schedule 6.01; (c) purchase money Indebtedness and capital leases not exceeding $25,000,000; (d) intercompany Indebtedness among Loan Parties; (e) ordinary course trade payables; (f) Swap Obligations permitted by Section 6.12; and (g) other unsecured Indebtedness not exceeding $35,000,000.

Section 6.02 — Liens

Create or permit any Lien on its property except: (a) Liens in favor of the Administrative Agent; (b) Liens listed on Schedule 6.02; (c) statutory liens for taxes not yet due or being contested; (d) carriers’, warehousemen’s, mechanics’ and similar liens arising by law; (e) purchase money Liens securing Indebtedness permitted under Section 6.01; (f) easements and minor encumbrances not materially interfering with business; and (g) deposits securing ordinary course obligations.

Section 6.03 — Fundamental Changes

Merge, consolidate, liquidate or dissolve, except that Subsidiaries may merge into the Borrower or another Loan Party, and the Borrower may consummate transactions that do not result in a Change of Control and in which the Borrower is the surviving entity.

Section 6.04 — Dispositions

Make Dispositions except: (a) sales of inventory in the ordinary course; (b) dispositions of obsolete or worn-out property; (c) leases and licenses in the ordinary course; (d) dispositions among Loan Parties; and (e) other Dispositions not exceeding $30,000,000 in any fiscal year, provided no Default or Event of Default exists.

Section 6.05 — Restricted Payments

Declare or make Restricted Payments except: (a) distributions to the Guarantor to fund taxes and ordinary corporate overhead; (b) distributions made when no Default or Event of Default exists and the Borrower is in pro forma compliance with Section 6.10; and (c) distributions necessary to maintain tax status, if applicable.

Section 6.06 — Change in Nature of Business

Engage in any material line of business substantially different from industrial manufacturing, distribution, infrastructure components, environmental services and related businesses conducted or contemplated as of the Closing Date.

Section 6.07 — Transactions with Affiliates

Enter into transactions with Affiliates except on terms no less favorable to the Borrower than would be obtained in an arm’s-length transaction, other than transactions among Loan Parties, compensation arrangements approved by the board of directors, and transactions expressly permitted by this Agreement.

Section 6.08 — Burdensome Agreements

Enter into any agreement that materially restricts the ability of any Loan Party to grant Liens in favor of the Administrative Agent, pay dividends or distributions to the Borrower, or repay intercompany obligations, subject to customary exceptions for purchase money financings, leases and permitted dispositions.

Section 6.09 — Use of Proceeds

Use proceeds of Loans or Letters of Credit to purchase or carry margin stock in violation of Regulation U or X, to fund any unlawful payment under Anti-Corruption Laws, or to finance activities involving any Sanctioned Person or Sanctioned Territory in violation of Sanctions.

Section 6.10 — Financial Covenants

Permit:

(a) the Total Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to exceed 3.75:1.00; provided that, following a permitted acquisition with aggregate consideration exceeding $50,000,000, such maximum ratio shall increase to 4.25:1.00 for the four fiscal quarters ending after such acquisition; or

(b) the Interest Coverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to be less than 3.00:1.00.

Section 6.11 — Amendments to Organization Documents

Amend its organizational documents in any manner materially adverse to the Lenders without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent.

Section 6.12 — Swap Agreements

Enter into Swap Contracts except for Swap Contracts entered into for bona fide hedging purposes and not for speculation. Swap Contracts with Swap Counterparties are expressly permitted, and Swap Obligations thereunder shall constitute Obligations secured and guaranteed under the Loan Documents.

ARTICLE VII — EVENTS OF DEFAULT

Section 7.01 — Events of Default

Each of the following shall constitute an Event of Default:

(a) the Borrower fails to pay principal of any Loan or any reimbursement obligation in respect of a Letter of Credit when due;

(b) the Borrower fails to pay interest, fees or any other Obligations within five Business Days after the date due;

(c) any representation or warranty made by any Loan Party in any Loan Document proves to have been materially incorrect when made;

(d) the Borrower fails to comply with Section 6.10, with no cure period;

(e) any Loan Party fails to perform or observe any other covenant in any Loan Document and such failure continues for 30 days after notice from the Administrative Agent;

(f) any Loan Party defaults under Material Indebtedness exceeding $15,000,000, or such Indebtedness becomes due prior to its scheduled maturity;

(g) the Borrower or Guarantor commences a voluntary bankruptcy or insolvency proceeding, makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, admits in writing its inability to pay debts, or consents to appointment of a receiver or trustee, which shall constitute an immediate Event of Default without notice or cure;

(h) an involuntary bankruptcy or insolvency proceeding is commenced against the Borrower or Guarantor and remains undismissed for 60 days;

(i) an ERISA event occurs that could reasonably be expected to result in liability exceeding $10,000,000;

(j) final judgments exceeding $15,000,000 in the aggregate remain unpaid, unstayed or undischarged for 30 days;

(k) any Loan Document, including the Guaranty, ceases to be in full force and effect, or the Guarantor contests the validity or enforceability thereof;

(l) a Change of Control occurs;

(m) any Lien purported to be created by a Security Document ceases to be valid and perfected, other than as permitted by the Loan Documents; or

(n) any material Security Document is asserted by any Loan Party to be invalid or unenforceable.

Section 7.02 — Remedies upon Event of Default

Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default other than an Event of Default under Section 7.01(g) or (h), the Administrative Agent shall, at the request or direction of the Required Lenders, by notice to the Borrower: (i) terminate the Revolving Commitments; (ii) declare all outstanding Obligations immediately due and payable; and (iii) exercise all rights and remedies under the Loan Documents and applicable law.

Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default under Section 7.01(g) or (h) with respect to the Borrower, the Revolving Commitments shall automatically terminate and all outstanding Obligations shall automatically become immediately due and payable, without notice, demand, presentment, protest or other requirement of any kind.

No additional notice to the Guarantor shall be required as a condition to the Guarantor’s liability under the Guaranty following acceleration under this Section 7.02. The Guarantor’s obligations under the Guaranty shall be enforceable immediately upon acceleration.

Section 7.03 — Application of Funds

"""Generate a tracked-changes redline from two .docx files.

Usage:
    python redline.py original.docx revised.docx redlined.docx \
        --author "Reviewer" --date 2026-04-30

Default mode: tries the `redlines` package (PyPI, JSv4) for paragraph-level
diffs, falls back to a manual SequenceMatcher + diff-match-patch
implementation when redlines isn't available.

Output is a .docx with native <w:ins>/<w:del> revision elements that render
in Word's Track Changes pane.
"""
import argparse
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from datetime import date
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path

import docx
from lxml import etree


W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
NSMAP = {"w": W}


def _paragraph_texts(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    d = docx.Document(str(path))
    return [p.text for p in d.paragraphs]


def _diff_words(a: str, b: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Return word-level diff ops as (op, text) pairs. op ∈ {'eq', 'ins', 'del'}."""
    try:
        from diff_match_patch import diff_match_patch
        dmp = diff_match_patch()
        diffs = dmp.diff_main(a, b)
        dmp.diff_cleanupSemantic(diffs)
        out = []
        for op, text in diffs:
            if op == 0:
                out.append(("eq", text))
            elif op == 1:
                out.append(("ins", text))
            else:
                out.append(("del", text))
        return out
    except ImportError:
        # Fallback: SequenceMatcher on words
        aw, bw = a.split(" "), b.split(" ")
        sm = SequenceMatcher(None, aw, bw)
        ops = []
        for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
            if tag == "equal":
                ops.append(("eq", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "delete":
                ops.append(("del", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "insert":
                ops.append(("ins", " ".join(bw[j1:j2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "replace":
                ops.append(("del", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
                ops.append(("ins", " ".join(bw[j1:j2]) + " "))
        return ops


def _make_run(text: str) -> etree.Element:
    r = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}r")
    t = etree.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}t")
    t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return r


def _make_ins(text: str, rev_id: int, author: str, when: str) -> etree.Element:
    ins = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}ins")
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}id", str(rev_id))
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}author", author)
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}date", when)
    ins.append(_make_run(text))
    return ins


def _make_del(text: str, rev_id: int, author: str, when: str) -> etree.Element:
    d = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}del")
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}id", str(rev_id))
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}author", author)
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}date", when)
    r = etree.SubElement(d, f"{{{W}}}r")
    t = etree.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}delText")
    t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return r.getparent()


def redline(original: Path, revised: Path, output: Path, author: str, when: str):
    # Use the original as the base document so styles/headers/footers are preserved.
    # Replace its body paragraphs with revision-marked versions.
    orig_paras = _paragraph_texts(original)
    rev_paras = _paragraph_texts(revised)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workdir:
        wd = Path(workdir)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as z:
            z.extractall(wd)
        doc_xml = wd / "word" / "document.xml"
        tree = etree.parse(str(doc_xml))
        root = tree.getroot()
        body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")
        if body is None:
            print("ERROR: no body in document.xml", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        # Find sectPr to preserve at end
        sect_pr = body.find(f"{{{W}}}sectPr")
        # Remove all existing paragraphs (we rebuild)
        for p in list(body):
            if p.tag != f"{{{W}}}sectPr":
                body.remove(p)

        sm = SequenceMatcher(None, orig_paras, rev_paras)
        rev_id = 1
        for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
            if tag == "equal":
                for text in orig_paras[i1:i2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_run(text))
            elif tag == "delete":
                for text in orig_paras[i1:i2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_del(text, rev_id, author, when))
                        rev_id += 1
            elif tag == "insert":
                for text in rev_paras[j1:j2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_ins(text, rev_id, author, when))
                        rev_id += 1
            elif tag == "replace":
                # Word-level diff for replaced paragraphs (assume 1:1 for now)
                pairs = list(zip(orig_paras[i1:i2], rev_paras[j1:j2]))
                # Handle unequal lengths by padding
                if len(orig_paras[i1:i2]) > len(rev_paras[j1:j2]):
                    # Extra deletions
                    pairs += [(t, "") for t in orig_paras[i1 + len(pairs):i2]]
                elif len(rev_paras[j1:j2]) > len(orig_paras[i1:i2]):
                    pairs += [("", t) for t in rev_paras[j1 + len(pairs):j2]]
                for a, b in pairs:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    for op, txt in _diff_words(a, b):
                        if not txt:
                            continue
                        if op == "eq":
                            p.append(_make_run(txt))
                        elif op == "ins":
                            p.append(_make_ins(txt, rev_id, author, when))
                            rev_id += 1
                        elif op == "del":
                            p.append(_make_del(txt, rev_id, author, when))
                            rev_id += 1

        # Restore sectPr at end
        if sect_pr is not None:
            body.remove(sect_pr)
            body.append(sect_pr)

        tree.write(str(doc_xml), xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)

        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for p in sorted(wd.rglob("*")):
                if p.is_file():
                    zout.write(p, p.relative_to(wd).as_posix())

    print(f"OK: wrote {output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("original")
    p.add_argument("revised")
    p.add_argument("output")
    p.add_argument("--author", default="Reviewer")
    p.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat() + "T00:00:00Z")
    args = p.parse_args()
    redline(Path(args.original), Path(args.revised), Path(args.output), args.author, args.date)
"""Add Word comments to a .docx by anchor-text matching.

Usage: python comments_add.py input.docx comments.json output.docx

comments.json is a list of objects:
    [{"anchor_text": "...", "author": "...", "comment": "..."}]

The first occurrence of each anchor is wrapped with a comment range. Pass the
same anchor multiple times to comment subsequent occurrences. Existing
comments in the document are preserved and new ones get fresh IDs.
"""
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from lxml import etree


W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
PR = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"
REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
CT = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"
COMMENTS_TYPE = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.comments+xml"
COMMENTS_REL = f"{REL}/comments"
NS = {"w": W, "pr": PR, "ct": CT}


def _next_id(comments_root) -> int:
    if comments_root is None:
        return 1
    ids = [int(c.get(f"{{{W}}}id", "0")) for c in comments_root.findall(f"{{{W}}}comment")]
    return (max(ids) + 1) if ids else 1


def _next_rid(rels_root) -> str:
    used = {r.get("Id") for r in rels_root}
    n = 1
    while f"rId{n}" in used:
        n += 1
    return f"rId{n}"


def _ensure_comments_part(wd: Path) -> Path:
    comments_path = wd / "word" / "comments.xml"
    if not comments_path.exists():
        comments_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        root = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}comments", nsmap={"w": W})
        tree = etree.ElementTree(root)
        tree.write(str(comments_path), xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)
    return comments_path


def _ensure_content_type(wd: Path):
    ct_path = wd / "[Content_Types].xml"
    tree = etree.parse(str(ct_path))
    root = tree.getroot()
    has_override = any(
        o.get("PartName") == "/word/comments.xml"
        for o in root.findall(f"{{{CT}}}Override")
    )
    if not has_override:
        override = etree.SubElement(root, f"{{{CT}}}Override")
        override.set("PartName", "/word/comments.xml")
        override.set("ContentType", COMMENTS_TYPE)
        tree.write(str(ct_path), xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)


def _ensure_rel(wd: Path) -> str:
    rels_path = wd / "word" / "_rels" / "document.xml.rels"
    tree = etree.parse(str(rels_path))
    root = tree.getroot()
    for rel in root:
        if rel.get("Type") == COMMENTS_REL:
            return rel.get("Id")
    rid = _next_rid(root)
    rel = etree.SubElement(root, f"{{{PR}}}Relationship")
    rel.set("Id", rid)

def add_runs(p, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None):
    # **bold** segments
    import re
    pos=0
    for m in re.finditer(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", text):
        if m.start()>pos:

        r=p.add_run(m.group(1)); r.bold=True; r.italic=italic
        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)

    if pos<len(text):

        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)

issues=[
("Immediate enforceability; no post-acceleration notice condition (items 4, 9–13, 33).","The Guarantor acknowledged a Credit Agreement that already provides, in Section 7.02, that no additional notice to the Guarantor is required following acceleration and that the Guaranty is enforceable immediately upon acceleration.     pos=0

        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)

    if pos<len(text):

        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)

content.text:
I've finished the Agent's counter-turn and the cover note to Thomas Kuo. Both files pass the docx validator and read back cleanly.

The redline is marked against MDLLP's markup with all their changes taken as accepted, so rejecting our changes gives you their draft and accepting them gives you ours. It has 123 tracked changes and 27 margin comments (WCS-0 to WCS-26) giving our position on each point. Of the 40 MDLLP changes and requests, we accept 9, counter-propose on 11, and reject or decline 20. Most of the rejections rest on the executed Credit Agreement, which the Guarantor signed as "acknowledged by":
- **Post-acceleration notice carve-out and 5-day demand grace period:** rejected. Section 7.02 says no further notice to the Guarantor is needed and the Guaranty is enforceable immediately on acceleration.
- **Termination right, reinstatement limit, immediate subrogation, marshaling and election-of-remedies deletions, jury waiver deletion:** rejected. Exhibit F (the agreed form of guaranty), the Term Sheet and Credit Agreement Sections 9.01 and 9.05 require them.
- **Net-worth liability cap:** replaced with a standard fraudulent-transfer savings clause. The cap would shrink to near zero when the group is in distress, and this is a parent guaranteeing its own subsidiary, so that risk is low.
- **Counter-offers:**
  - payment-only guaranty, with clarifying language on what it covers;
  - New York statute of limitations, with accrual on demand;
  - intercompany payment block triggered only by an Event of Default (or by a blockage notice during a lesser Default);
  - courtesy copies of default notices;
  - damages waiver kept alongside the jury waiver;
  - Guarantor consent only for amendments that increase its obligations.

Things you should know before this goes out:
- **No embedded comments in the markup.** The [TK1]–[TK10] comments the email refers to aren't in the file. I responded to them from the email's descriptions, and the cover note says so.
- **Mixed markup conventions.** Their markup mixed real tracked changes with typed "[DELETED: …]" and "[ADDED: …]" text. I treated all of it as proposed changes.
- **Undefined term.** MDLLP used "Excluded Swap Obligations" without defining it; I added the standard definition and a matching eligible-contract-participant representation (new 6.7).
- **Our own cross-reference error.** Section 12.1 of our June 16 draft (and their new paragraph) pointed to Credit Agreement 9.04 for assignments; the right section is 9.06. Both are fixed.
- **Notice emails don't match.** Diana Chow's email appears three different ways across the Guaranty, the Credit Agreement and the transmittal, and Thomas Kuo's differs between the Guaranty and the Credit Agreement. I flagged these for confirmation rather than changing them.
- **Compliance certificate figures.** The leverage (2.45x) and interest coverage (5.80x) figures I cite come from the Credit Agreement's form of compliance certificate (Exhibit C), dated after the markup. The cover note describes them as figures shown in that exhibit.
- **Dates and legend.** The cover note is dated July 8, 2025, from Priya Narayan. The redline carries a "WCS Draft 7/8/2025" legend at the top, to come out of the execution version. Change either date if needed.
- **No fallback positions included.** The cover note is written to go to opposing counsel, so it doesn't list the Agent's fallback positions.

Files are in /workspace/output:
- counter-turn-redline.docx
- cover-note.docx
